subject: expression: `PropagateType` should never let orignal data overflow (#53045)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff in `pkg/expression/expression.go`: `PropagateType` now adjusts propagated DECIMAL (flen, decimal) so the integer-part width is never reduced below the original, preventing intermediate DECIMAL overflow when propagating CAST(DECIMAL AS DOUBLE) precision (e.g., very large DECIMAL inputs). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched expression logic; later upstream history keeps the same overflow-avoidance logic (only refactors around context/min usage).
